usage: forseti semantic-loop [-h] --function NAME [--store-root DIR]
                             --mode {propose,submit,check-only}
                             [--candidates-json FILE] [--provider PROVIDER]
                             [--model MODEL] [--prompt-id PROMPT_ID]
                             [--prompt-version PROMPT_VERSION]
                             [--propose-model PROPOSE_MODEL]
                             [--claude-bin CLAUDE_BIN]
                             [--propose-timeout SECONDS] [--max-candidates N]
                             [-k UNWIND] [--unwind-ladder K1,K2,...]
                             [-t SECONDS] [--json] [--esbmc-bin ESBMC_BIN]
                             source [ESBMC_ARG ...]

The composed semantic-property loop (#213): ingest candidate properties for
<source>::<function> per --mode (propose from the LLM proposer, submit
already-formed ones, or skip ingestion and check what's already stored), then
check every stored, checkable property with ESBMC and report Core's own worst-
outcome-wins `outcome`: held | violated | unknown | error | empty. Replaces
calling `propose`/`submit-property` and `check` separately and re-deriving
that decision yourself.

positional arguments:
  source                source file defining the unit
  ESBMC_ARG             flags forwarded verbatim to esbmc; place them after a
                        `--` separator, e.g. `... file.c --function f --mode
                        check-only -- -DNDEBUG`

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --function NAME       the function under test (the `symbol` of
                        `path::symbol`)
  --store-root DIR      the .forseti store directory (default: .forseti)
  --mode {propose,submit,check-only}
                        how to ingest candidates before checking
  --candidates-json FILE
                        --mode submit only: a file containing a JSON array of
                        candidate objects ({"expression": ..., "domain":
                        [...], "referenced_params": [...], "rationale": ...}),
                        each validated and persisted independently
  --provider PROVIDER   --mode submit only: who/what produced these
                        candidates, e.g. "codex"
  --model MODEL         --mode submit only: the model that produced these
                        candidates, e.g. "gpt-5.1"
  --prompt-id PROMPT_ID
                        --mode submit only: provenance prompt id for these
                        candidates (default: host-submitted)
  --prompt-version PROMPT_VERSION
                        --mode submit only: provenance prompt version for
                        these candidates (default: 1)
  --propose-model PROPOSE_MODEL
                        --mode propose only: LLM model for the proposer
                        (default: sonnet)
  --claude-bin CLAUDE_BIN
                        --mode propose only: claude binary to invoke (default:
                        claude on PATH)
  --propose-timeout SECONDS
                        --mode propose only: proposer LLM timeout in seconds
                        (default: 240)
  --max-candidates N    cap on accepted candidates (default: 6)
  -k, --unwind UNWIND   loop unwind bound k (default: 4)
  --unwind-ladder K1,K2,...
                        comma-separated bounds tried after --unwind on an
                        UNKNOWN verdict (default: whichever of 8,16 exceed
                        --unwind, so raising -k/--unwind alone still works)
  -t, --timeout SECONDS
                        per-attempt esbmc timeout in seconds (default: 110)
  --json                emit the run as a JSON object (the MCP tool's payload)
  --esbmc-bin ESBMC_BIN
                        esbmc binary to invoke (default: esbmc on PATH)

usage: forseti [-h] [--version]
               {verify,list-units,synth,discharge,propose,submit-property,check,semantic-loop,claude-code-hook,codex-hook,omp-hook,enable-project,disable-project,mcp} ...

Forseti Core: write -> verify -> counterexample -> fix.

positional arguments:
  {verify,list-units,synth,discharge,propose,submit-property,check,semantic-loop,claude-code-hook,codex-hook,omp-hook,enable-project,disable-project,mcp}
    verify              run ESBMC on a source and report a typed verdict
    list-units          list a C source's function definitions and their
                        parameter types
    synth               synthesise a memory precondition for a unit and verify
                        against it
    discharge           verify a unit's memory precondition and discharge it
                        at its callers
    propose             propose candidate properties for a unit and persist
                        the survivors
    submit-property     ingest a host-generated candidate property -- no LLM
                        call
    check               check a unit's stored properties with ESBMC, one
                        verdict each
    semantic-loop       ingest candidates (per --mode), then check them with
                        ESBMC -- one call
    claude-code-hook    run a Claude Code verify-gate hook (internal; wired by
                        enable-project)
    codex-hook          run a Codex verify-gate hook (internal; wired by
                        enable-project)
    omp-hook            run an Oh My Pi verify-gate hook (internal; wired by
                        enable-project)
    enable-project      install/update the verify-gate hooks for a project's
                        harness
    disable-project     remove forseti's own verify-gate hook entries for one
                        harness
    mcp                 start the Core MCP server on stdio (needs the 'mcp'
                        extra)

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --version             show program's version number and exit

usage: forseti synth [-h] --function NAME [--max-len N] [-t SECONDS]
                     [--esbmc-bin ESBMC_BIN] [--emit-only] [--json]
                     source

Read an L0 memory precondition off <source>::<function>'s type signature
(RFC-0003 S2), materialise a valid object per pointer in a generated sidecar
(the source stays pristine), and verify with unwinding assertions on + a
k-ladder + a non-vacuity check. A pass is reported honestly as VERIFIED
*assuming valid caller pointers* (undischarged).

positional arguments:
  source                C source file defining the unit

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --function NAME       the pointer-taking function under test (the `symbol`
                        of `path::symbol`)
  --max-len N           symbolic-length ceiling for `(ptr, len)` shapes
                        (default: 8); a VERIFIED is 'assumed up to len<=N'
  -t, --timeout SECONDS
                        per-run esbmc timeout in seconds (default: 60)
  --esbmc-bin ESBMC_BIN
                        esbmc binary to invoke (default: esbmc on PATH)
  --emit-only           print the generated sidecar C harness and exit (no
                        verification)
  --json                emit the assessment as a JSON object
